subject: Cristiano Ronaldo
title: Ronaldo's red card and the own goal debate

lines.vo: Ronaldo's first Champions League game for Juventus ended with a red card.
lines.footage: Juventus v Valencia Ronaldo red card highlights

lines.vo: Five Ballons d'Or later, the headlines keep coming.
At the 2006 World Cup came the Rooney incident. Then a season of boos. Red card, Rooney, boos. Classic.
lines.footage: 2006 World Cup Rooney Ronaldo incident clip

lines.vo: At school he was expelled. By his own account, he threw a chair at a teacher. His first red card, basically.
This October the league credited him with a goal. Opta logged it as an own goal. A goal with two owners.
Thirty-five trophies. Seventeen Champions League goals in one season. Not bad for an expelled student.
Now he is up for Best Middle East Player again. He won it last time. Keep the chairs on the floor.
Think you can call the next one? Betting tips, news and predictions at aboutfootball dot UK.

inserts.story: A cartoon trophy cabinet is so full that its door is held shut by a single chair. A caricature of Ronaldo opens it and a flood of cups pours out. Twist: the last item is a tiny envelope marked Shortlist, and he puts the chair back, gently.
inserts.characters: generic cartoon cabinet; caricature of Cristiano Ronaldo

inserts.story: A cartoon principal writes EXPELLED on a blackboard. A caricature of Ronaldo sits down on a school chair very gently, as if it might bite. Twist: the principal slides over a notebook and asks for an autograph.
inserts.characters: generic cartoon principal; caricature of Cristiano Ronaldo

inserts.story: A cartoon VAR screen shows two scoreboards: one says RONALDO, one says OWN GOAL. A caricature of Ronaldo and a tiny cartoon defender tug at one ball like two kids. Twist: the ball splits in two, both roll into the net, and both scoreboards are happy.
inserts.characters: generic cartoon referee and defender; caricature of Cristiano Ronaldo
